title: BuildYard.ai — The Portfolio for Real AI Work
excerpt: BuildYard.ai is the portfolio for real AI work. Builders post structured, real-identity workflows — the problem, the AI tools, the output, and the impact — or upload Skills directly, and Companies discover and hire for proven AI fluency instead of a resume line.
content_html: BuildYard.ai connects two groups: Builders, professionals in Finance, GTM, Legal, and Operations who share real AI workflows as a structured public portfolio (the problem, the AI workflow, the output, and the impact) or upload Skills — Claude and OpenAI-style packages — directly, and Companies, organizations that browse those portfolios to discover and hire for proven AI fluency instead of a resume line.
